description: This Java class defines a command named 'LoggingExpired' used within the Eclipse Ditto framework to enable logging expiration on a specific connectivity connection identified by a ConnectionId. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing back to JSON, and is annotated as an immutable JSON-serializable command.

classes.name: LoggingExpired
classes.description: Immutable command class representing a logging expiration notification for a specific connection within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It supports creation from parameters or JSON, and can serialize to JSON payload.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new LoggingExpired instance for a given connection ID, with optional headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to deserialize a LoggingExpired command from a JSON string or object, with optional headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of this command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into a JSON object, considering schema version and predicate.
